name: Open Rack V2 with 18 Barreleye G2 servers
description: Imported exterior from Akeil commit 051c9d954292438fc8419661aa91451367961d86. The rack frame is 0.600 m wide, 1.067 m deep and 2.210 m tall in asset space. Authored dimensions are metres; current ancestor transforms in the accepted scene establish any explicit user resizing. Source axes are +X right, +Y front-to-rear, +Z up. RealityKit converts source [X,Y,Z] to [X,Z,-Y], so in THIS assembly parent coordinates +X is right, +Y is up, and +Z is toward the rack front. Pull a server out by increasing its parent-space position.z; preserve its existing rotation and scale. Child transforms and mesh dimensions use source metres before the assembly scale. This exterior package contains the frame and 18 joined server exteriors. Current scene children and advertised detail templates establish which additional representations are installed or available. This faithful native derivative preserves all source server geometry, normals and materials, indexes repeated normals for smaller storage, and corrects only the independently verified PSU6 source offset. It is derived from the exact source asset, not a procedural replacement.
